# Vendored code

`qrcode.mjs` is the ESM build of **qrcode-generator 2.0.4**.

- Author: Kazuhiko Arase
- License: MIT
- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Vendored: unmodified, including its copyright header.

It is vendored rather than depended on because the plugin must stay a single
self-contained directory that the DSH profile can install without a build step.
